test: 20 consecutive runs of the He-like Fe XXV reproducer (free-ion SCF, then PlasmaScreen mu = 0.05 with radial:hxs_iter0 = 8) on builds with identical flags (-O2 -fPIC, no workaround)
other_evidence: Fe III gref at mu = 0.1 crashed deterministically at -O0 without the fix (PotentialHX1 returned jmaxk = 0x55555555 under lldb) and runs on the fixed build; all 148 framework energies of the earlier sweeps are reproduced exactly (max |dE| = 0 eV) by the fixed -O2 build with no workaround flag.
note: The pre-fix behaviour is non-deterministic (uninitialised stack), e.g. Fe III gref mu = 0.1 passed once on the pre-fix -O2 build; a pass on the pre-fix source therefore proves nothing.
